import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
from pathlib import Path
import json,subprocess,sys,os,hashlib
lane=Path.cwd(); p=json.loads(Path('PINS.json').read_text())
def write(n,s):subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(lane/'write_lane.py'),n],input=s,text=True,check=True,capture_output=True)
write('audit/WalkParityModularAxioms.lean','module\npublic import URMatchingWalkParity\n@[expose] public section\n#print axioms URMatching.permutation_walk_parity\n#print axioms URMatching.permutation_closed_walk_even\n')
e=dict(os.environ,LEAN_PATH=':'.join([str(lane/'build')]+p['upstream_lean_paths']),LEAN_NUM_THREADS='1')
r=subprocess.run([p['lean_bin'],'-j1','-M3500','-DwarningAsError=true',str(lane/'audit/WalkParityModularAxioms.lean')],env=e,capture_output=True,text=True)
print('Lean exit',r.returncode,r.stdout,r.stderr);write('audit/WalkParityModularAxioms.txt',r.stdout+r.stderr);assert r.returncode==0
result=json.loads(Path('inputs/previous-r6/338806.json').read_text())

result['r7_evidence']={n:hashlib.sha256(Path(n).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for n in ['src/URMatchingWalkParity.lean','build/URMatchingWalkParity.olean','r7_parity_compile_012.output.txt','r7_parity_compile_012.receipt.json','r7_parity_kernel_013.output.txt','r7_parity_kernel_013.receipt.json','audit/WalkParityModularAxioms.txt']}
write('results/338806.json',json.dumps(result,indent=2))
write('CHECKPOINT.md','# R7 active partial checkpoint\n\nScientific HOLD, credit 0, 57/60 unchanged. 37 immutable baseline modules plus WalkParity strict/kernel/scoped-axiom green. Exact SHA256 evidence in results/338806.json. Evenness of genuine closed walks proved. IsCycle extraction, destruction, girth, retention, ratio, standard/source bridges and endpoint remain unpaid.
